note: The 4-clip family intro video (fun, exciting, introductory, family time). Each clip: 'scene' = the still picture (Flux), 'motion' = what happens (Wan 2.2). Claude joins them afterwards with titles, a 'Sawasdee!' voice and nongchang.co.uk.

clips.scene: pops out of a glowing tablet on the coffee table of a cosy family living room in the evening, surrounded by golden sparkles and orange marigold petals, while a mum, a dad, a girl about 7 and a boy about 10 sit on the sofa behind, looking amazed
clips.motion: the baby elephant bursts out of the glowing tablet in a shower of golden sparkles and marigold petals and waves his trunk hello, the children jump up from the sofa with huge delighted smiles and the parents laugh, fast playful camera push-in

clips.scene: bounces happily on the rug in a bright living room next to a tablet, with a mum, a dad, a girl and a boy sitting around him cheering, golden stars floating in the air
clips.motion: the family cheers and high-fives as golden stars burst from the tablet, the baby elephant does a happy little dance and claps his trunk, lots of laughter and bouncing energy

clips.scene: sits on a sunny kitchen counter beside a plate of mango sticky rice and ripe mangoes, with a dad holding up a mango, a boy grinning, and a mum and a girl laughing nearby
clips.motion: the dad holds up a mango, the boy proudly says a word, the baby elephant nods and raises his trunk happily, the mum laughs and the girl claps, warm cosy family moment

clips.scene: stands in a golden Thai temple garden at sunset with floating lanterns in the sky, beside a happy family of a mum, a dad, a girl and a boy, everyone facing the camera, calm empty sky in the top third
clips.motion: the whole family and the baby elephant press their hands together in a Thai wai greeting, bow, then wave happily at the camera, lanterns rise slowly into the sky, camera gently pulls back, magical and celebratory
